name: Ordway
summary: Ordway publishes no prices for its billing software and provides a 30-minute demo instead. Its Recurring Payments product combines a card auto updater with automated payment retries and dunning workflows.

facts.text: Ordway's blog says its Recurring Payments product integrates credit card auto updater functionality with automated dunning, retry logic and cash application.

The blog says the updater covers Visa, Mastercard, American Express and Discover, and that updates run on a daily or weekly batch or in real time when a decline occurs. It does not say what the service costs.

Ordway's FAQ defines a dunning email as a system-generated reminder sent when a customer's invoice becomes past due, and advises sending only to billing or accounts payable contacts from the seller's own domain.
The product page describes automated retries and smart dunning workflows, but gives no retry counts or schedule.
The homepage offers a '30-minute Ordway demo with one of our sales engineers'. It does not describe the demo as free.

hiddenCosts: No prices are published on the product page or the homepage. The ordwaylabs.com/pricing URL returned 404.
